# Séance 0.3.30
Séance now updates Claude Code for you, so your chats keep access to external drives. When Claude Code replaced itself under running chats, macOS stopped those chats, and everything they ran, from reading external drives until they restarted. It showed up as "low max file descriptors (Unexpected)". Claude Code's own updater is now off in every chat Séance starts. When a newer Claude Code is out, the sidebar says so. Update Claude Code… in the Séance menu, or in Settings → Agents, waits for working chats to finish, quits them, installs the update and reopens each chat in its tab. Each one comes back on the same conversation, account, model and effort, with any unsent text put back. This works when Claude Code was installed with npm.
Selecting a project no longer opens a stray shell beside your chats. A project's only shell now shows as an ordinary row in the sidebar.
Claude accounts signed in with a subscription token now say so in Settings → Agents, with the renewal date, instead of "Not signed in".
